title: Towards Tsallis Fully Probabilistic Design
summary: Fully Probabilistic design (FPD) is a powerful framework offering an elegant and unifying account of stochastic control, learning and decision-making. Here we introduce a generalized FPD framework, which we term as Tsallis FPD. Tsallis FPD uses Tsallis divergence in place of the Kullback-Leibler divergence that defines the standard FPD cost term. Tsallis divergence is a natural generalization of the KL divergence, rooted in non-extensive statistical mechanics and providing flexibility towards modeling stochastic processes with non-Gaussian tail behavior.
